rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The government memorial site's page 'Oath of Office as sworn by President Nelson Mandela at his inauguration, Pretoria', with the dateline 10 May 1994, reproduces the oath in which Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela swears to be faithful to the Republic 'in full realisation of the high calling I assume as Executive President'.
